Its more specific genes are lymphocyte-associated (CD2, GIMAP4/5/7, FYN, CORO1A, FCMR, ITGA4, S1PR4, RORA, MAF, KLF3), which suggests a T-cell add-on or resting-lymphocyte state. The core T-cell factor (CD3E, TRAC, CD3D) sits in another metagene, and naive markers (CCR7, LEF1, TCF7, SELL) are not here, so this is a weak, shared signal rather than a clean subtype.

label: BTG2/SOCS3/CD69-high
description: Diffuse factor with broad, low-specificity weight (effective number about 2100) on BTG2, SOCS3, CD69, NFKBIZ, CYTIP, CD37, CORO1A and LAPTM5, which are genes of resting or recently activated lymphocytes. It does not carry the immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, IER2 peak in other metagenes), and KLF2 and TXNIP also peak elsewhere, so this is not a clean dissociation or IEG factor. It could be a lymphocyte activation or stress-adjacent state, or a generic T/B-cell background, and I cannot resolve which.

label: CD44/CD37/LSP1-high
description: Diffuse, low-specificity metagene with a very large effective number of genes (about 1778) and low specificities across most top genes. The top genes (CD44, UCP2, CDC42SE1, CD37, LSP1, RASGRP2, ARHGEF1, KLF13, MYADM) mix leukocyte-wide and lymphoid-leaning genes with housekeeping and RNA-processing genes (CIRBP, RACK1, UBA52, B2M). No single lineage is clearly indicated, so it is most likely a broad background or quality-related factor. Alternatives are a memory/activated lymphocyte signal (CD44, CD37, ARHGEF1) or a stress or ambient component; the evidence does not separate them.

label: KLF2/TXNIP/IKZF1-high
description: Diffuse factor with a resting or quiescent lymphocyte flavor: KLF2, TXNIP, IKZF1, ETS1, FCMR, S1PR4, ITGB7 and ARHGEF1 are prominent, but the top genes have low specificity (0.02-0.06) and the effective gene count is large (~1742). Core naive T markers (CCR7, SELL, TCF7, LEF1) and CD3E sit in other metagenes, and B-cell markers (MS4A1, CD79A) also peak elsewhere, so this is not a clear lineage call. It most likely captures a shared quiescence or circulation signature in lymphocytes, with KLF2/TXNIP stress-like genes possibly contributing; the alternatives are a generic lymphocyte background factor or a dissociation or ex vivo handling response.

label: Inflammatory activated monocytes
description: Acute inflammatory activation program in myeloid cells, combining NF-kB and immediate-early response genes (NFKBIA, TNFAIP3, NFKBIZ, DUSP1, IER2, JUNB, ZFP36) with monocyte-restricted inflammatory cytokines and chemokines (IL1B, CXCL8, CCL3, CXCL2, G0S2, NLRP3). The specificity of IL1B, CXCL8, CCL3 and G0S2 is near 1 and CD14 and LYZ are not in this factor, so it reflects activated monocytes rather than a lineage-wide stress response. The immediate-early component may partly reflect dissociation or handling stress.
